# clio help

Global flags: --db --backend --bank --actor --output (-o). Output mode: an explicit `--output`/`-o` always wins; otherwise text on a terminal (TTY) and JSON when piped. Forms: `--output json`, `--output=json`, `-o json`, `-o=json`. Empty values: a value flag given an empty value (`--bank ''`) is refused on every command; leave the flag off to take the default. Use -- after the command before positional text that starts with -; keep flags before it. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 domain or runtime failure, 2 usage error or documented command refusal (ops repair or backup restore), 3 is a command-specific degraded outcome (clio ops reindex, backup prune or backup create --keep, or backup restore). 75 means the command could not report a clean success and that nothing was lost or invalid, and the command's own message says whether a retry helps: a storage lock conflict is cleared by retrying, and a restore that left a derived difference is not. Process stops caused by SIGPIPE, SIGINT, or SIGTERM cannot report a CLI error; shells that use the 128+signal convention show these as 141, 130, or 143, outside the command exit codes

## Usage

```
clio help [--json] [--markdown --out DIR] [TOPIC]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TOPIC` | no | Names a known command to open its help for, a `group verb` topic included; with no topic the whole catalog prints. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  |  | Selects the JSON catalog `cli_top_level` prints. |
| `--markdown` |  |  | Writes the whole Markdown manual (one page per leaf command plus an index) into `--out DIR` instead of printing; exclusive with `--json` and with a TOPIC. |
| `--out DIR` | text |  | Names the directory `--markdown` writes the manual into; required with `--markdown`, refused without it. |

## Examples

Print the catalog screen.
```
clio help
```

Open one group's help from the catalog.
```
clio help backup
```

Print the machine-readable catalog.
```
clio help --json
```

Write the whole Markdown manual into ./manual.
```
clio help --markdown --out ./manual
```
